result.topic_en: Algebraic identities for the cubic norm form $a^3+nb^3+n^2c^3-3nabc$ with $n=v^3$, its factorisation via $\Delta=a+vb+v^2c$, the associated quadratic forms A, B, C, and expansions of ratios of these forms in terms of $v$ and $\Delta$.
result.transcription:
Fr
$a^3 + nb^3 + nnc^3 - 3nabc = D$ \qquad VIII.22

$n = v^3$
$a + vb + vvc = \Delta$
$aa - nbc = A$ \quad $A - vvB = (a - vb)\Delta$ \quad $AA - nBC = aD$
$bb - ac = B$ \quad $vB - C = (b - vc)\Delta$ \quad $nBB - AC = bD$
$ncc - ab = C$ \quad $vC - A = (vvc - a)\Delta$ \quad $CC - AB = cD$

$D = \Delta(A + vvB + vC)$
$A^3 - nnB^3 = D(a^3 - nb^3) = D(aA - nbB)$
$A^3 - nC^3 = D(a^3 - nnc^3) = D(aA - ncC)$
$nB^3 - C^3 = D(b^3 - nc^3) = D(bB - cC)$

[-D-] $\Delta^3 - 3a\Delta^2 + 3A\Delta - D = 0$
$\Delta^3 - 3vb\Delta^2 + 3vvB\Delta - D = 0$
$\Delta^3 - 3vvc\Delta^2 + 3vC\Delta - D = 0$

$\frac{C}{B} = v + \left(\frac{nc}{A} - \frac{b}{B}\right)\Delta + \frac{vc\Delta\Delta}{AB}(a - vb) = v + \frac{vc - b}{B}\Delta$

$\frac{A}{C} = v + \left(\frac{a}{C} - \frac{nc}{A}\right)\Delta + \frac{vc\Delta\Delta}{AC}(nc - va) = v + \frac{a - vvc}{C}\Delta$

$\frac{nB}{A} = v + \left(\frac{b}{B} - \frac{a}{C}\right)\Delta + \frac{a\Delta\Delta}{AC}(a - vvc)$
$\quad - \frac{b\Delta\Delta}{AB}(a - vb) = v + \frac{vvb - va}{A}\Delta$

$\frac{A}{B} = vv -$ \qquad $= vv + \frac{a - vb}{B}\Delta$
$\frac{nB}{C} = vv -$ \qquad $= vv + \frac{vvb - nc}{C}\Delta$
$\frac{nC}{A} = vv -$ \qquad $= vv + \frac{vnc - vva}{A}\Delta$

Fr
